articles.title: Jones Seeks Third Term as 146th District Court Judge
articles.excerpt: Jack Jones was first elected to the 146th District Court seat in 2012, succeeding Morris (Killeen Daily Herald).

articles.title: Bell County Elected Officials to be Sworn in Today
articles.excerpt: He was among those scheduled to administer oaths, as "Retired Judge Rick Morris," at the swearing-in of Bell County officials at the first Commissioners Court meeting of 2023 (Killeen Daily Herald).
